title: Publishing a calibration guide update
passage:
Document 1 — Portal editing guide
Each machine family has one permanent public download link. Replace the PDF behind the link when approving an update; do not email the updated PDF itself to distributors. A workshop-only draft must stay in the staff folder. In the public changelog, list only changes that alter what an operator must do. A clearer drawing alone does not need an entry.

Document 2 — Reviewer’s message
I approved Guide K7 revision 4 for public use. It has a clearer drawing on page 2 and asks operators to wait for a steady indicator before writing down the reading on page 3. The wait is new. I did not approve revision 5; it is the workshop trial with an extra measurement step. It contains the same drawing and waiting instruction as revision 4.

Document 3 — Distributor email
The original K7 link still opens revision 3 when I try it. Please tell me how to get the approved document. My trainers highlighted an extra measurement step in a printout labeled revision 5, but they don’t know whether to teach it. They also want one sentence for their lesson plan explaining what operators should now do differently.
passageZh:
文件一｜入口網站編輯指南
每個機型系列都有一個固定的公開下載連結。核准更新後，請替換連結指向的 PDF；不要把新版 PDF 本身用電子郵件寄給經銷商。只供工坊使用的草稿要留在員工資料夾裡。公開更新紀錄只列出會改變操作員做法的事項；單純把圖畫得更清楚不必記載。

文件二｜審查員訊息
我已核准 K7 指南第 4 版供公開使用。第 2 頁的圖畫得更清楚；第 3 頁要求操作員等指示燈穩定後再記錄讀數。等待指示燈是新增的要求。我沒有核准第 5 版；那是工坊試驗稿，另有一個量測步驟。裡面的圖和等待指示與第 4 版相同。

文件三｜經銷商來信
我試了 K7 原本的連結，仍然會開啟第 3 版。請告訴我如何取得核准的文件。講師在標為第 5 版的列印稿上劃出額外量測步驟，但不確定該不該教。他們也希望教案裡有一句話，說明操作員現在應做哪些改變。
